description: This file defines SQL functions related to OpenID Connect (OIDC) user information and logout procedures for the SQLPage application, including functions to access user claims, ID tokens, and generate secure logout URLs.

methods.name: user_info_token
methods.description: Returns the entire ID token as a JSON object for the current user, allowing access to all claims.

methods.name: user_info
methods.description: Retrieves specific user claim information, such as name, email, or sub, based on the claim name parameter.

methods.name: oidc_logout_url
methods.description: Generates a secure URL to log out the user from the application and the OIDC provider, with CSRF protection and redirect options.
